owner: Loring LiquidCool Data Center LLC / LiquidCool Data Center
capacity_notes: Initial phase reported at 5-6 MW. March 2026 local reporting says the leased warehouse has 2 MW already available plus a Versant Power will-serve agreement for 24 MW; company has discussed potential expansion up to 50 MW, but financing and operational start were not confirmed.
status: local process; long-term lease signed for Building No. 7230, but financing/permitting/operational start not confirmed

history.previous_status: leased; planned conversion at former Loring Air Force Base warehouse

contradictions: Capacity is reported in several layers: initial 5-6 MW, 2 MW existing in Building No. 7230, 24 MW Versant will-serve, and potential 50 MW expansion. capacity_mw remains 6 for the initial phase; higher figures are noted but not treated as current operating capacity.

October 2025 sources projected operation roughly six months after announcement, but March 2026 reporting said financing was still being finalized and operation could be around six months after financing; no official operational confirmation was found in this refresh.
why_not_in_baseline: Small-market former military/industrial-site conversion in northern Maine; baseline did not include Loring LiquidCool or Green 4 Maine campus.
